textos.Queda en Documentos como referencia: un: It goes to Documents as a reference: a summary with its main ideas. To study all of it, better as a Book project.
textos.Queda en ~/Esquema, con su propio histor: It stays in ~/Esquema, with its own history. I split it into chapters and, before summarizing, I ask you what you want it for.
textos.Quedan como preguntas abiertas en el doc: They stay as open questions in the document
textos.Resumí «{x}», pero algunos capítulos fal: I summarized «{x}», but some chapters failed
textos.Sale de la documentación y los enlaces a: It leaves the documentation and links to it become plain text. It stays in the version history and you can undo it.
textos.Si lo dejas vacío, tu IA le pone uno: Leave it empty and your AI will name it
textos.Tu IA compara lo que se pidió con lo que: Your AI compares what was asked with what changed in the code (commits and files, read only) and writes «How it turned out». It also proposes updating the other documents: you decide which.
textos.Tu IA está trabajando en la documentació: Your AI is working on the documentation
textos.Tu IA lo confirma (o te avisa) en su pri: Your AI confirms it (or tells you) in its first answer.
textos.Va a Documentos: tu IA lo resume, saca l: It goes to Documents: your AI summarizes it, picks out the key points, draws a diagram and notes the open questions.
textos.Va a Historias de usuario. Tu IA la enti: It goes to User stories. Your AI understands it, asks you what's missing and documents it. It doesn't code.
textos.Ya hubo tres rondas de preguntas: lo que: There were already three rounds of questions: what's missing is in the document's «Open questions».
textos.{ia} cree que esto es {x}. Si tiene razó: {ia} thinks this is {x}. If it's right, delete it and add it again with that type.
textos.{ia} está comparando lo pedido con lo qu: {ia} is comparing what was asked with what changed
textos.«{x}» está en la Papelera: desde ahí lo: «{x}» is in the Trash: you can get it back from there
textos.«{x}» está listo para leer y estudiar: «{x}» is ready to read and study
textos.¿Actualizo también la wiki de GitHub con: Should I also update the GitHub wiki with this version?
textos.¿Cuál es el repositorio de GitHub de est: What's this project's GitHub repository? Its wiki is another repository that Esquema builds from your documentation.
textos.¿Qué tipo de proyecto es?: What kind of project is it?
textos.Gracias: tu IA sigue con lo que respondi: Thanks: your AI continues with what you answered
textos.Listo: lo que no respondiste queda como: Done: what you didn't answer stays as an open question
textos.Subiendo a la wiki con tu git…: Uploading to the wiki with your git…
textos.De qué trata y el mapa de ideas: What it's about and the map of ideas
textos.Pégala y tu IA te ayuda a entenderla: te: Paste it and your AI helps you understand it: it asks what's missing and documents it. It doesn't code.
textos.Pégala: tu IA te ayuda a entenderla y la: Paste it: your AI helps you understand it and documents it.
textos.Por capítulo: un esquema, preguntas de r: Per chapter: an outline, review questions with answers and flashcards.
textos.Contradicciones, fechas o nombres que no: Contradictions, dates or names that don't match and loose ends, with the quote and where it is.
textos.Un acta, una especificación, un artículo: Meeting notes, a spec, an article or a book: Esquema detects what it is and files it.
textos.Notas, apuntes o textos de referencia: t: Notes or reference texts: your AI summarizes them and files them in Notes.
textos.Pídele a tu IA un mapa, una línea de tie: Ask your AI for a map, a timeline or an outline.

Tell it what you want to see and it draws it.

textos.Esa dirección no sirve. Usa la del repos: That address doesn't work. Use the repository's, for example https://github.com/ana/mi-app.

textos.Esquema no lee ese formato sin programas: Esquema can't read that format without extra programs. Save it as .docx, PDF or text, or copy the text and paste it here.
